leadText:
Dr. Proctor (Japanese: ドクター・ドク Doctor Doc) is a character of the day who appeared in A Chansey Operation. He is a doctor for humans, who was forced to treat injured Pokémon after an accident involving and a truck load of stolen Pokémon.

Dr. Proctor is a womanizer; he made advances on , Jessie, and Nurse Joy. However, these attempts failed on Misty and Nurse Joy, but not on Jessie, who fell for him immediately.

Proctor also appeared to be very lazy, but mostly, he had very little confidence that he could treat Pokémon, as he had no experience in the matter. He didn't want to open up his hospital to treat any of the injured Pokémon until , , and Nurse Joy convinced him to. However, once he was engaged, he became a skilled and competent physician, treating his patients with confidence and compassion. He also proved to be a formidable fighter, using his medical equipment as weapons to help foil 's attempt to steal all of the injured Pokémon again.

==Trivia==
Dr. Proctor appears to be based on , a character on the American drama . Rikaya Koyama, Dr. Proctor's Japanese voice actor, was the voice of Dr. Ross in ERs Japanese dub. Like Dr. Proctor, Dr. Ross is a womanizer. And, as Dr. Proctor was drawn to look like Dr. Ross, he looks like an animated version of Dr. Ross's actor, .
